verification.notes: TokenSwap address listed in QuickSwap docs ('TokenSwap (swap QUICK OLD for NEW)'). Verified source: SWAP_RATIO constant 1000, old QUICK sent to 0xdead, new QUICK paid from contract balance (~67.98M new QUICK at simulation). Actively used (quickToQuickX txs on 2026-09-25/28). withdrawTimeout (block 35486210) has passed, so owner can withdraw liquidity at any time. Press reports of an Aug-2026 DAO vote: ratio 1:1000 until 2026-11-04, then 1:750 / 1:500 / 1:250 monthly, contract closing 2027-02-05; the deployed contract's ratio is a constant, so the reduced ratios would require a new/updated contract — re-verify after 2026-11-04.

verification.notes: Conversion contract (address from the official migration site bundle; verified source 'Conversion'). lockAndConvert() takes the caller's ENTIRE KWENTA balance (no amount arg; approve ≥ balance). Lock (90d) and linear vest (270d) from 2024-11-15 have fully elapsed, so vest() pays the full 17× SNX immediately. Deadline: withdrawSNX() lets the Synthetix treasury sweep all SNX from VESTING_START_TIME+WITHDRAW_START = 2026-11-15; after that conversions yield nothing. SNX liquidity ~1.06M at check time.

If the staking contract is refilled, this check turns Ready on its own and the steps below will work: start unstaking, wait about 10 seconds, unstake, then migrate THALES to OVER 1:1.
